honest_takeaway: R² ≈ 0.99 looks great on raw price charts, but the naive baseline performs just as well (RMSE 154.04 vs 155.46). Directional accuracy is only ~54%, and after accounting for 0.1% transaction costs, both ML trading strategies trailed Buy & Hold (-10.4% and -12.8% vs +35.2%). A high R² on non-stationary financial data does not indicate real forecasting edge.
